messages:
incident-bot: Pager: latency.regression detected for inference-pool-us-west2 — p95 uplift ~3.2x over the last 6m. Alerting threshold breached.

liz-oncall: seeing it on the dashboard. p50 looks OK, p95 and p99 spike. Investigating traces now.

eva-eng-sre: can someone grab a kernel uname and perf stat from an impacted node? Run `ssh host-34` then `uname -r && sudo perf stat -e cycles,instructions,cache-misses -p $(pgrep -f redwood-runtime)`

liz-oncall: ran quick check on host-34: `uname -r` -> `6.2.0-21-rt` (same across impacted hosts). Perf snippet:
```
Performance counter stats for 'runtime pid 8127':
     1,324,788,345      cycles
       812,345,123      instructions
        42,109,876      cache-misses
```

ashok-eng-ml: I dumped a couple of span traces for /v1/generate:
`trace://redwood/traces/7f3a9c` shows a large tail inside tokenizer ~55ms and kernel syscalls cluster around 75-90ms in some spans. p95 appears concentrated at tokenization + syscalls.

taylor-eng-runtime: sharing `strace -f -tt -p 8127` snippet from an impacted container: `futex` syscalls spike and some __kernel_vsyscall messages. Also seeing intermittent EBUSY on mmap during cache eviction path.

marco-eng-infra: network/QoS looks fine for the AZ. No interface errors on NICs. Host CPU steal is low. Could be a kernel-level scheduler or futex contention regression.

liz-oncall: customer-facing update: @beth-cs we have increased latency for a subset of routed requests in us-west2. No data loss; degraded p95 only. ETA for next update 15m.

beth-cs: ack. I'll notify affected customers with the high-level note and link to this thread.

eva-eng-sre: hypothesis 1: recent kernel RT patches changed futex or syscall path scheduling -> higher tail latency under our worker pattern. Hypothesis 2: runtime memory reclaim path + mmap churn (KV cache eviction) causing syscalls to stall.

ashok-eng-ml: adding that model batch sizes rising due to a traffic burst at 10:22 may have increased eviction rate. I see concurrent batch size histograms bump at 10:21-10:24.

taylor-eng-runtime: mitigation attempt 1: reducing max_batch to 1 on 6 containers in the pool. Applying now: `redwoodctl route update --pool inference-usw2 --max-batch 1 --selector node:host-34`

liz-oncall: applied to 6 hosts. Monitoring.

(1m later)

eva-eng-sre: early signal: p95 dropped ~22% on those hosts, cluster-level p95 down ~8%. Not fixed.

marco-eng-infra: alternative mitigation: divert traffic to us-west1 canary for non-SLA customers. Need approval for partial reroute.

liz-oncall: go ahead for non-SLA traffic. `@marco-eng-infra` start shift.

marco-eng-infra: started re-route 30% non-sla -> us-west1. Monitoring traces: the heavy tails remain for some requests still hitting us-west2.

ashok-eng-ml: can we correlate kernel upgrade timestamp with onset? Any hosts upgraded in last deploy window?

taylor-eng-runtime: checked host bootstrap logs: apt history shows kernel 6.2.0-21-rt installed at 2026-03-16T23:40:12 on the pool, but we only started seeing regression post deploy at 10:20 today. There was a micro-ops kernel livepatch applied at 10:05 to a subset of nodes (patch id kp-211).

eva-eng-sre: good catch. KPI: let's collect perf top samples before/after livepatch on two pinned hosts. Can someone run `perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 30` and upload the `perf.data`?

liz-oncall: uploading perf shard from host-34 to /logs/incident/1769994321/host-34-perf.data (link: https://internal/redwood/logs/1769994321/host-34-perf.data)

(taylor posts)
```
perf top -p 8127 (host-34 after patch):
  24.2%  runtime_kernel
  12.0%  tokenization_impl
  8.3%   futex_wait
  6.7%   mm_mmap
```
```
perf top (host-21 before patch):
  15.1% runtime_kernel
  14.8% tokenization_impl
  1.9%  futex_wait
```

ashok-eng-ml: stark difference: futex_wait up ~4x after patch. That aligns with p95 tail.

eva-eng-sre: mitigation 2: roll the kernel livepatch on a small subset back (hosts 34, 36) to see immediate delta. Requesting infra approval.

marco-eng-infra: approved for 2 nodes. Rolling back livepatch on host-34 and host-36 now. Command: `kpctl rollback --id kp-211 --hosts host-34,host-36`

liz-oncall: rolling on host-34 confirmed. Re-running quick perf sample.

(90s later)

taylor-eng-runtime: host-34 perf top after rollback: futex_wait down to ~2.1% and runtime_kernel down ~10%. p95 for that host down ~38%.

eva-eng-sre: rollback positive. This strongly ties the regression to kp-211 livepatch affecting futex/syscall path.

beth-cs: customer note update: telling customers we identified a kernel livepatch as probable cause; we have partial rollback and traffic mitigations in place. Will update again soon.

liz-oncall: next steps:
- SRE: expand rollback to remaining impacted nodes in waves, measure.
- Infra: hold kp-211 in canary flag until vendor provides patch or we get deeper root cause.
- Runtime: look for lock/futex patterns in our threading model to reduce contention as medium-term.
- ML: throttle batch autoscaling thresholds to avoid eviction spikes.

ashok-eng-ml: I'll adjust autoscaler policy: reduce max-concurrency by 25% for 30m.

marco-eng-infra: rolling rollback to 10 more nodes in small waves starting now.

(10m later)

eva-eng-sre: cluster p95 trending down to normal baseline after wider rollback and batch caps. Recording this thread as the live RCA timeline and artifact links:
- perf data: https://internal/redwood/logs/1769994321/
- traces: https://internal/redwood/traces/7f3a9c, 9b2c1f
- kernel patch id: kp-211 (candidate regression)

liz-oncall: handing off to next oncall for long-form RCA and postmortem: `@taylor-eng-runtime` will lead the writeup. Next oncall window covers 11:00-15:00 PST.

taylor-eng-runtime: taking handoff. I'll assemble timeline, attach perf bundles, and draft mitigations. Please add any outstanding artifacts here.

eva-eng-sre: tagging for follow-up: regression label, kernel, futex, p95, perf.

liz-oncall: closing pager for immediate live mitigation; monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
